import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();ids=set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']));r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());p=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());assert set(r)==ids==set(p)
assert sha(Path('TASK.txt').read_bytes())=='dfd20f9b3d10a83a3a08f05c64130f5be76b151a912c52a5368f14e7ae8aa469'
for k,v in p.items():
 raw=Path(f'originals/{k}.jsonl').read_bytes();token=Path(f'originals/{k}.statement-token.json').read_bytes();dec=Path(f'originals/{k}.statement.txt').read_bytes()
 assert sha(raw)==v['raw_line_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n')==v['ends_newline']
 assert sha(token)==v['statement_token_sha256'] and sha(dec)==v['decoded_utf8_sha256']
 assert json.loads(token)==dec.decode()==json.loads(raw)['statement']==r[k]['literal']['complete_statement']
ledger=Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True);prev='0'*64
for i,b in enumerate(ledger):
 d=json.loads(b);assert d['seq']==i and d['previous']==prev;prev=sha(b)
 if d['event']=='success':assert sha(Path(d['destination']).read_bytes())==d['sha256']
budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(l) for l in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert len(charges)==budget['calls_used']==3 and sum(len(c['queries']) for c in charges)==budget['queries_used']==9
for name in ['one','two','three']:assert isinstance(json.loads(Path(f'search-response-{name}.json').read_text()),str)
validation={'ids':20,'original_bindings':'all pass','task_hash':'pass','guard_chain':'pass','success_payload_hashes':'pass','search_continuity':'3calls9queries','mathematical_checks':'None: documentary validation only','self_credit':0,'frozen_after':'Standalone next; terminal manifest afterward'}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'documentary-validation.json'],input=json.dumps(validation,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(json.dumps(validation))
